name: KSTDC Mayura Restaurant Badami
description: Clean, hygienic, state-run restaurant situated within the KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya campus. Serves traditional North Karnataka meals (Jolada Rotti Oota) alongside South Indian breakfast and standard North Indian vegetarian/non-vegetarian dishes.
location: Ramdurg Road, Badami, Bagalkote District, Karnataka 587201
hygiene_and_safety: Government audited standards; filtered RO drinking water
accessibility: Ground floor dining hall with ramped entrance

name: Kudala Sangama Maha Dasoha Bhavana
category: Universal Free Community Dining (Dasoha) / Spiritual Tradition
description: Massive community dining hall at Kudala Sangama operating according to 12th-century Basava Sharana principles. Serves free, wholesome, hot vegetarian meals (Prasada) to all visitors, pilgrims, and tourists regardless of caste, religion, or economic status twice daily.
location: Kudala Sangama Pilgrim Complex, Hunagund Taluk, Bagalkote District, Karnataka 587118
operating_hours: 11:30 AM - 03:30 PM and 07:30 PM - 09:30 PM daily
pricing_level: Free for all visitors (Voluntary donations accepted by Board)
hygiene_and_safety: Steam cooking plant; hygienic community dining tables
accessibility: Ramp access into dining halls; special seated dining for elderly and persons with disabilities
source: Kudalasangama Development Board & Official Bagalkote District Portal

name: Original Amingad Kardant Sweet Outlets
description: Traditional sweet shops in Amingad village (Hunagund Taluk) and district branches specializing in the century-old, GI-contender sweet 'Amingad Kardant'. Made with pure edible gum, ghee, organic jaggery, and premium dry fruits, without any artificial preservatives.
location: Main Highway Road, Amingad, Hunagund Taluk, Bagalkote District, Karnataka 587112
specialty_dishes: Amingad Kardant (Dry fruit & jaggery gum fudge)
pricing_level: Moderate (₹400 - ₹800 per kg depending on dry fruit grade)
hygiene_and_safety: Hygienically packaged boxes suitable for travel and gifting
accessibility: Street front retail counter with easy roadside access
source: Official Bagalkote District Portal & Karnataka Tourism
